prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Use Alt+P to show or hide your companion anytime. Double-click your pet to open quick actions.", "Got It, Launch Pet!", "Alt + P toggles pet visibility instantly."]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Archetype", "Select a pet persona that best matches your daily workspace dynamic.", "Playful Dog / Calm Cat / Energetic Dragon", "Preview Pet Sounds"]
2: ["Your Pet is Hatching!", "Tap the egg below while we build your custom 3D companion desktop model.", "Model Generation Progress"]
3: ["Select Your Creation Journey", "Pick a ready-made desktop companion or build a unique pet from photo uploads.", "Instant Ready Pet vs Custom Photo Creation"]
4: ["Sign in with your primary email to ensure your pet attributes and customized items never get lost.", "Permanent Cloud Sync Enabled"]
5: ["Polishing 3D animations and configuring desktop overlay settings..."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is registered! It will appear floating near your system tray once setup completes.", "If your desktop pet is hidden behind full-screen apps, press Alt+P to bring it to the front."]
7: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click below to send your pet onto your desktop screen.", "Release Pet to Desktop"]
8: ["Completing onboarding unlocks 3 exclusive celebration animations for your pet!", "Includes Free Animation Pack"]
9: ["Play Chime when Ready"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and exclusive gift unlocks.
